svg.title: Nursing assistant — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as nursing assistant, wearing a care tunic. Visible work cue: A blood-pressure cuff connects through an open hose to a round pressure gauge with a single needle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face and round glasses.
